editorial.overview: The NetApp Certified Technology Solutions Professional Exam is officially certified by NetApp and evaluated through Pearson VUE. It assesses professional technical knowledge across three major domains: Infrastructure, Data Storage Software, and Intelligent Data Infrastructure. Candidates comprehensively demonstrate their competency in managing NetApp solutions, virtualization concepts, storage software like ONTAP, and hybrid cloud data protection solutions.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official NetApp documentation on storage software components like ONTAP and StorageGRID comprehensively before your test. Focus your study efforts on data mobility solutions, hybrid cloud data protection components, and virtualization concepts. Practice applying your technical knowledge to real-world infrastructure scenarios before taking the exam via Pearson VUE.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam is intended for IT professionals and storage administrators with experience in NetApp technologies who design, deploy, and manage enterprise infrastructure, data storage software, and intelligent data solutions across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments.
